name: Suzuki TS250X
intro: A liquid-cooled two-stroke trail bike sold in Europe and Japan.

B: Suzuki's CCI system pumps oil into the engine, so it does not need premix. Check the oil tank, pump and lines. If the pump was removed, it runs premix.

recallNote: Off-road models are not always in the NHTSA recall search. Ask a Suzuki dealer to run the VIN as well.
